function.name: report_safety_emergency
function.description: FIRST action, even mid-booking, when the caller reports a CURRENT gas smell, a carbon monoxide (CO) alarm going off, smoke or a burning smell from the system, or electrical sparking. A fixed evacuation and 911 message plays BEFORE the backend request. Do not call update_intake first or ask any administrative question. Not for hypothetical questions. This records the emergency and pages the dispatcher; it does not contact 911 or send anyone.

hazard.description: gas_smell: smells gas/rotten eggs. carbon_monoxide_alarm: CO detector sounding. smoke_or_burning_smell: smoke or burning smell from furnace/AC/vents. electrical_sparking: sparks, arcing or melting wires at the equipment.

caller_quote.description: Short verbatim caller quote reporting the hazard.

messages.content: Please get everyone out of the home now, and don't use light switches or appliances. Once you're safely outside, call 911.
